name: Can I request specific final detail work during my project?
description: Yes, clients can request specific final detail work, typically during the punch list phase, by communicating with their project manager.

mainEntity.name: Can I request specific final detail work during my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, clients can and often do request specific final detail work. These requests are usually incorporated during the punch list phase, where you and the contractor walk through the completed project to identify any outstanding items or areas needing attention. Clear communication with your project manager is essential to ensure your specific concerns are addressed before project handover.
